* OTA-DRIVE-SKY130 : NMOS-input current-mirror (symmetrical) OTA, cascoded class-A output
* Dominant pole at the load node (CL-compensated), B=3 current gain, 320uA tail
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
* reference: 10uA enters IBIAS -> NMOS diode
XB0 IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=5 l=1 m=2
* tail 320uA
XT TAIL IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 m=32
* input pair (M1 on VINN feeds sink path, M2 on VINP feeds source path)
XM1 N1 VINN TAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=50 l=0.5 m=5
XM2 N2 VINP TAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=50 l=0.5 m=5
* PMOS mirrors 1:3
XM3 N1 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.5 m=8
XM5 P5 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.5 m=24
XM4 N2 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.5 m=8
XM6 P6 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.5 m=24
* PMOS cascodes
XM5C NM VBPC P5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.5 m=24
XM6C VOUT VBPC P6 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.5 m=24
* NMOS wide-swing cascode mirror 1:1
XM7C NM VBNC Q7 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.5 m=14
XM7 Q7 NM VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.5 m=14
XM8C VOUT VBNC Q8 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.5 m=14
XM8 Q8 NM VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=0.5 m=14
* cascode bias generators (10uA each, density-matched replicas + IR offsets)
XBN1 VBP IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=5 l=1 m=2
XBP0 VBP VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 m=1
XBP1 VBNC VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 m=1
XBNC VBNC VBNC XN VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.5 m=1
RN XN VSS 20k
XBN2 VBPC IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=5 l=1 m=2
XBPC VBPC VBPC XP VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=5 l=0.5 m=1
RP VDD XP 30k
.ends DUT
